Contestants

The 21 castaways were officially announced on August 25, 2026. This is the first Survivor season to start with an odd number of castaways since Survivor: Fiji in 2007, the first season whose opening cast had a female majority (eleven women and ten men), and the first to start with a gender imbalance since Survivor: San Juan del Sur (which had ten men and eight women). Notable cast members this season include actor Devin Way, voice actress Ana Sani, and former WWE NXT wrestler Brady Booker.[5][6][7][8]

7281"Permanent Uncertainty"Days 1–30.8/12[11]September 23, 2026 (2026-09-23)4.38[11]

Jeff Probst welcomes the 21 new castaways to Survivor and reveals that they will be playing with "Permanent Uncertainty". The castaways are then marooned together on one beach with limited supplies and no set tribal lines. The players discover a sign informing them that not everyone will start the game together, as they must agree on one person to begin the game on their own. Lewis volunteers to go on the journey.

  • Journey: Lewis goes on a journey and is sent to Exile Island. On Day 2, he must chop down a thick mast within a set time limit to claim the Hidden Immunity Idol at the top. However, Lewis fails to chop down the mast before time runs out and is unsuccessful in earning the idol.

Back on the beach, a helicopter arrives. Aaliyah, Devin, Jelly, and Ori solidify an alliance, dubbed the "Helicopter Alliance", bringing up Sharonda as a fifth member. The helicopter drops off a bag containing their tribe buffs, revealing the new tribe divisions: Savu consisting of Alexis, Ana, Carter, Cristian, Eric, Kristin, Linnea, Ori, Rob, and Sharonda, and Toka consisting of Aaliyah, Brady, Devin, Jelly, Jenna, Kilby, Maggie, Mike, Patt, and Thien An.

Each tribe nominates one member to negotiate with the other tribe for supplies. Kristin and Kilby are selected from their respective tribes and agree to split the supplies. Savu takes the fishing gear, flint, machete, and pot, while Toka takes the camping and shelter-building supplies.

At Toka, Jenna struggles to open up to her tribemates. Aaliyah, Devin, and Jelly reconnect, solidifying their half of the Helicopter Alliance. Brady and Devin grow closer and discuss targeting Jenna first. Devin also spreads around camp that Jenna may be lying about her profession.

At Savu, Ori and Sharonda solidify their half of the Helicopter Alliance, hoping to keep their connection a secret. Eric begins to rub his fellow tribemates the wrong way, which Rob takes advantage of by painting a bigger target on him. The next morning, Rob finds a Hidden Immunity Idol.

Before the Immunity Challenge, Probst welcomes the castaways to the "Open Era", explaining that anything from past Survivor seasons could be brought into play. The castaways are informed that the coin flip from Survivor 50: In the Hands of the Fans is back in play. The coin flip could increase the prize pot to $2,000,000 or eliminate the player who chooses to flip the coin. If the player is eliminated, the money rolls over to the subsequent season.

  • Immunity Challenge: Tribes must race through intersecting obstacles to untie five bags containing balls. Once they retrieve all five balls, they must push them through a vertical chute to release a key. Players then use the key to unlock six heavy crates and push them underneath a cargo net to create a staircase. After all tribe members climb the staircase, two players must assemble a logo puzzle to win immunity.

Savu wins immunity, sending Toka to the first Tribal Council. Devin continues to target Jenna. Some players believe Aaliyah should go after her performance caused the tribe to fall behind during the challenge. Aaliyah and Jelly bring up Brady as a potential future target to Jenna and Patt over his behavior. Believing Jenna did good in the challenge and wanting her to stay, Patt privately informs Jenna that she could be the one going home. Jenna tells Brady about Aaliyah's criticisms of him, which causes him to target Aaliyah. He and Devin disagree over who to vote for.

At Tribal Council, Jenna admits that she struggled to open up during the first few days. Devin boldly reveals that he is voting for Jenna, causing the tribe to whisper and scramble to figure out how to vote. After accidentally saying there is two targets, Patt reveals that the other is Aaliyah, who is shocked at this. Both Aaliyah and Jenna play their Shots in the Dark, but are both "Not Safe". Aaliyah is voted out in a 6–2 vote over Jenna.

7292"Weaponized Honesty"Days 3–50.8/11[12]September 30, 2026 (2026-09-30)4.69[12]

At Toka, Jenna is grateful to still be in the game, while Brady and Devin discuss their closeness despite being on opposite sides of the vote. Lewis leaves Exile Island and joins Toka. The following day, Brady accidentally chops a piece of his thumb while using the axe. After receiving medical attention, he is treated and allowed to remain in the game.

At Savu, Ana and Alexis discuss Linnea and Sharonda as the tribe's biggest threats. Carter talks to Ana about how he believes Alexis is a threat, being cut off when Alexis walks up to them. Ana lies to Alexis that they were talking about popcorn, which Alexis doesn't believe. This causes Alexis to throw Ana under the bus to Linnea and Sharonda.

  • Reward Challenge: Tribes divide into pairs, with one member of each pair blindfolded. Their partner must guide them over a hinged ramp and through a net obstacle. Next, two blindfolded members must unwind a rope from a log, releasing three sandbags. Finally, three tribe members must assemble a pole and hang the sandbags from a hook. The first tribe to finish wins a reward consisting of a hammock, a mat, pillows, and two tarps.

During the challenge, Kristin injures her foot. After a close finish, Toka wins the reward. Savu returns to camp with Rob expressing frustration with Linnea's performance during the challenge. Toka celebrates their reward win, giving Jelly an opportunity to search for a Hidden Immunity Idol, which she finds. Jelly and Patt discuss forming an alliance with Brady, Devin, and Mike.

  • Immunity Challenge: Tribes must swim out to a floating platform and release a massive Survivor whale. They must then maneuver the whale and all tribe members over a barrel before dragging it onto the beach beneath an obstacle. Once there, three tribe members must roll three balls down a long table, landing one in each of three holes. The first tribe to finish wins immunity.

Toka wins their first immunity challenge, sending Savu to Tribal Council. At Savu, several tribe members discuss voting out Eric, and Ana volunteers to serve as the decoy vote to prevent Eric from suspecting he is the target as well as build trust with the other tribemates. Linnea and Sharonda overhear Cater and Ori talking about hunting crabs, mistaking their conversation for strategy talk. Rob struggles with being away from his family and considers sacrificing his own game to save Eric. At Tribal Council, Rob pulls Eric aside before the vote to warn him that the tribe is targeting him. However, Ana is voted out in a 6–4 vote over Eric, with Rob unsuccessfully attempting to cast a vote for himself.

7303"What I'm Smellin' is Stinky"Days 5–7TBAOctober 7, 2026 (2026-10-07)TBD

At Savu, Carter is confused and upset after finding himself on the wrong side of the vote. Rob begins to complain of pain in one of his legs and asks medical to examine him. Medical finds a cut on Rob's foot, but ultimately find nothing that would warrant them to pull him from the game. Despite this, Rob remains worried about infection and quits the game anyway. In confessionals, multiple of Rob's tribemates suspect his true reasons for quitting being due to his failures at the previous Tribal Council. Before leaving, Rob bequeaths his Hidden Immunity Idol to Carter.

At Toka, Lewis worries about his standing in the tribe after arriving three days late. Devin suspects that Kilby is playing a rat-like game. Patt informs her alliance of Brady, Devin, Jelly, and Mike that Kilby talked trash about Brady to her.

  • Journey: Each tribe must send a member to visit the opposing tribe, with Savu sending Carter and Toka sending Devin. Once aboard the boat, they each receive a clue to an advantage hidden on the opposing tribe's beach. However, the journey comes with an additional decision, as each castaway may choose to mutiny and remain with the opposing tribe as a new member.

At Savu, Devin pulls Sharonda and Ori aside to solidify their Helicopter Alliance. Devin and Sharonda find the Extra Vote advantage at the water well. At Toka, Carter informs the tribe that Linnea and Sharonda are running Savu. While Carter is away, Lewis searches Carter’s bag and discovers the clue to an advantage, prompting Brady and Maggie to find and argue over it. After grabbing it, Brady ultimately gives the Extra Vote advantage to Maggie. Carter fails to return to the boat on time and is forced to mutiny to Toka.

  • Reward/Immunity Challenge: Tribe members must crawl through a pile of wood shavings to collect keys. Two players then use the keys to unlock heavy chains wrapped around a crate and retrieve a ladder. Using the ladder, they climb to the top of a tower, where they hoist a bag of coconuts and toss it down the other side to retrieve a key hidden inside. The tribes must then get all their members up a steep platform, where two players assemble a hanging anchor puzzle. The first tribe to finish wins immunity and four egg-laying hens.

During the challenge, Toka squanders its substantial lead during the puzzle, allowing Savu to win immunity and reward. At Toka, Devin and Kilby attempt to resolve their differences, but the conversation instead solidifies Devin's desire to vote Kilby out. Meanwhile, Lewis aligns with Carter. The two newcomers emerge as swing votes, with the other tribe members being divided between Brady, Devin, Jelly, Mike, and Patt on one side and Jenna, Kilby, Maggie, and Thien An on the other. Thien An proposes voting out Patt, seeing her as a social threat. She attempts to recruit Brady, but he remains convinced that Kilby will go. At Tribal Council, Patt is voted out in a 6–5 vote, with Lewis and Carter choosing to go with Thien An's plan.
